$comment: Design tokens — the single source of truth.
Android, web and iOS each need these values in their own syntax. Typing
them three times guarantees drift: someone adjusts a hex value for a
contrast fix on web, nobody touches Android, and six months later the two
products no longer look like the same company. The divergence is never
caught in review because no single diff shows both.
So they are declared once here and generated. Run:
Values are placeholders pending real design work (P0-DES-01). The
*structure* is the deliverable: one place to change, generated everywhere,
and a CI check that fails if the generated files are stale.

color.$comment: Neutral-first surfaces with a single brand accent. Status colour is never the only signal — every status is also carried by an icon or a label, so the UI works for colour-blind users.

typography.$comment: Scale from docs/05-screens-ux.md §5. Sizes in points; platforms convert (sp on Android, rem on web).

spacing.$comment: 4pt base grid. Keys are multiples of 4, so --space-3 is 12px — the name states the value.

accessibility.$comment: Enforced by the generator, not merely documented — see design/generate.mjs.

font.$comment: One geometric-humanist sans for UI. Tabular figures are applied per-context, not globally — money and hours must align in columns, but proportional figures read better in prose.

shadow.$comment: Flat surfaces with hairline dividers; elevation is reserved for genuinely floating elements. Dark mode drops the card shadow entirely — a shadow on a dark surface reads as smudge rather than depth.
